'''Kirkin Liawoon''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kirkin lived in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Kirkin was an ambassador for the [[Overden]] of [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] to the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].
